name: composer
description: Multi-line input + submission shell for chat. Submits on Enter (Shift+Enter inserts newline). Trailing slot for attachment + send buttons.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on each keystroke.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed value on Enter or form submit.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Lock the input and suppress submission (e.g. during streaming).

props.name: submitOnEnter
props.description: Submit when Enter is pressed without Shift. Disable to require button click.

props.name: children
props.description: Trailing slot — attachment buttons, voice toggle, send button, etc.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the form wrapper.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Trailing action buttons rendered after the textarea.

examples.title: Basic composer
With attachment slot
examples.description: Attach button on the leading edge of the trailing slot.
examples.code:
<Composer value={v} onValueChange={setV} onSubmit={send}>
  <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={pickFile}><Paperclip /></Button>
  <Button type="submit">Send</Button>
</Composer>

ai.whenToUse: Wrap any user-input surface in an AI app — chatbots, AI editors, agent prompts. Pair with `useChat` from @ai-sdk/react or any equivalent state hook.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for non-chat forms (use Form + Textarea). Don't bake fetch/streaming logic into onSubmit — keep the network call in the consumer.
commonMistakes: Calling onSubmit with the raw event instead of the value — onSubmit receives the trimmed string already
Forgetting to clear `value` after submit — Composer is fully controlled
Wrapping the component in <form> — Composer renders its own form element
ai.accessibilityNotes: Renders a real <form> + <textarea>, so Enter submission and screen-reader announcements work without extra ARIA. Pass `aria-label` on the wrapper if there's no visible label.
